title: Template literal se sentence banao
starterCode:
const name = "Rahul"
const score = 95
const total = 100
// Template literal se return karo: "Rahul scored 95 out of 100"
solution:
const name = "Rahul"
const score = 95
const total = 100
return `${name} scored ${score} out of ${total}`
hints: Backtick ` use karo string ke liye
